citation.title: Acute 24-h fasting, ambulatory blood pressure and autonomic cardiovascular control in healthy young adults
citation.journal: Am J Physiol Regul Integr Comp Physiol

population.description: Twenty-five healthy young adults (14 M, 11 F), age 23 +/- 3 yr, BMI 24 +/- 4 kg/m2; no history of autonomic dysfunction, hypertension, diabetes, tobacco or medication; screened normotensive. Female participants tested in the early follicular phase.

protocols.name: fast_24h
protocols.description: Fasted condition: 24 h postprandial (water ad libitum), blood drawn on arrival at the laboratory for the autonomic test; modelled as a short 30 min arm read at minutes 29-30. Clock hour of arrival and of the sample are not stated (08:00 assumed); the 24 h is as printed. The paper says a standardized meal was provided 'for each condition' without saying when or how much in the fasted one; not entered.

findings.description: Whole-blood glucose (Cholestech LDX, whole blood; the paper does not say plasma-equivalent) on arrival after the 24-h fast, mean +/- SD, n = 25; entered as glucose as other whole-blood meter values are
Whole-blood beta-hydroxybutyrate (Precision Xtra) after the 24-h fast, mean +/- SD, n = 25

left_out.what: Fed condition (3-h postprandial) glucose 98.8 +/- 11.7 mg/dL and BHB 0.128 +/- 0.13 mmol/L (Table 1): the standardized meal is given as one third of daily energy need at about 55/20/25% carbohydrate/fat/protein, but the energy (and each person's daily need) is not printed
Total, LDL and HDL cholesterol after the 24-h fast, 172.7 +/- 29.1, 105.5 +/- 21.5, 56.2 +/- 20.3 mg/dL (Table 1)

Overall 24-h ambulatory heart rate (65 +/- 10 beats/min), systolic (108 +/- 7), diastolic (63 +/- 6) and mean arterial pressure (78 +/- 5) in the fasted condition, mean +/- SD, n = 20 (Table 2; wake and sleep values only in Fig. 3): the 24 h monitored are the 24 h of the fast, so the arm starts at the last meal, a 'standardized' meal of one third of each person's daily energy need at about 55/20/25% carbohydrate/fat/protein, whose energy and grams are not printed (the activity factor behind the need is not given); the clock hour, and the hours slept (actigraphy-defined, not printed), are also not stated
Fed 24-h ambulatory values and the fed-minus-fasted differences (Table 2, Results): the fed day is a normal diet, its meals not printed

Fasted systolic (107 +/- 11) and diastolic (58 +/- 10) pressure from the Finometer during 10 min of paced breathing, supine, after instrumentation (Table 3): the minutes between the blood sample and this recording are not printed
R-R interval (1,059 +/- 186 ms) and spectral heart rate variability (HF power, HFnu, LFnu) during paced breathing (Table 3): the paper prints no RMSSD, the model's hrv; R-R interval is not heart rate
Stroke volume, cardiac output and total peripheral resistance (Table 3), pulse contour estimates, supine
Cardiovagal baroreflex sensitivity (Tables 3 and 4; Table 4 is mean +/- SE, n = 22)
Muscle sympathetic nerve activity (Tables 3 and 4, n = 12)
